headline: Tawhid Hridoy hits double century abroad against South Africa 'A'
summary: The Bangladesh 'A' skipper joins an elite list of batters including Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim to score a first-class double ton overseas.
details: Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy scored a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' on the third day of the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.
Hridoy reached his milestone off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six, helping the visitors close in on the hosts' first-innings total of 512.
This marks Hridoy's second double century in first-class cricket, having previously scored 217 for BCB South Zone against North Zone in Chattogram.
The 24-year-old now joins an elite group of Bangladeshi batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, alongside Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, and Shahriar Hossain.
While Mushfiqur and Shakib achieved the feat in Test matches, Shahriar Hossain was the first to do so in first-class cricket in 2003 in Karachi.

caption:
Tawhid Hridoy joins the elite list of Shakib and Mushfiqur after smashing a double century in South Africa!

Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy scored a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' on the third day of the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.

Hridoy reached his milestone off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six, helping the visitors close in on the hosts' first-innings total of 512.

This marks Hridoy's second double century in first-class cricket, having previously scored 217 for BCB South Zone against North Zone in Chattogram.

The 24-year-old now joins an elite group of Bangladeshi batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, alongside Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, and Shahriar Hossain.

While Mushfiqur and Shakib achieved the feat in Test matches, Shahriar Hossain was the first to do so in first-class cricket in 2003 in Karachi.

In addition to Hridoy's feat, Jaker Ali narrowly missed a century with 94 runs, while Mohammad Saifuddin scored 87 off 171 balls.

Hridoy and Saifuddin shared a massive 185-run partnership for the sixth wicket.

Bangladesh 'A' finished the day on 471 for six, trailing South Africa 'A' by 41 runs in the first innings.

headline: 3 firearms recovered as two held for shooting at BNP leader's home
summary: Police arrested JCD's Demra unit convener and an associate in connection with the attack on SM Reza Chowdhury Selim's residence.
details: Police arrested two people, including Masud Rana, the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal's Demra thana unit convener, and his associate Taposh, in connection with a shooting at the house of BNP leader SM Reza Chowdhury Selim.
During separate drives in Dhaka's Demra and Narayanganj's Rupganj, police recovered three firearms, two magazines, and 13 rounds of ammunition.
The firearms, which included an old single-barrel shotgun and two pistols, were found in an abandoned room in Rupganj and a sunshade at Taposh's rented house.
The incident occurred on Friday dawn when eight to nine helmeted individuals arrived at Selim's residence and opened fire.
With these latest arrests, a total of three people have been detained in connection with the shooting.
Police are now preparing to file a separate case under the Arms Act following the recovery of the weapons.
caption:
Three firearms and 13 rounds of ammunition recovered after police arrest two suspects in a shooting attack on a BNP leader's home.

Police arrested two people, including Masud Rana, the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal's Demra thana unit convener, and his associate Taposh, in connection with a shooting at the house of BNP leader SM Reza Chowdhury Selim.

During separate drives in Dhaka's Demra and Narayanganj's Rupganj, police recovered three firearms, two magazines, and 13 rounds of ammunition.

The firearms, which included an old single-barrel shotgun and two pistols, were found in an abandoned room in Rupganj and a sunshade at Taposh's rented house.

The incident occurred on Friday dawn when eight to nine helmeted individuals arrived at Selim's residence and opened fire.

With these latest arrests, a total of three people have been detained in connection with the shooting.

Police are now preparing to file a separate case under the Arms Act following the recovery of the weapons.
